skills.subject: math
skills.title: Count to 20 by 1s
skills.description: What number comes next when you count by 1s? Start at any number, like 7, 8, 9, and keep going to 20.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: What numbers are used for
skills.description: Numbers tell us how many, which one is first or second, and names like player number 24. Pick how the number is being used.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: See up to 5 at once
skills.description: Look quickly at some dots and tell how many there are, without counting one by one.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Read and type numbers to 20
skills.description: Match numbers from 0 to 20 to groups of things. Tap or type the number you see.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Counting up and counting down
skills.description: Count up and the number gets bigger. Count down and it gets smaller. Which way did it go?

skills.subject: math
skills.title: More, less, or the same
skills.description: Look at two groups and tell which has more, which has less, or if they are the same.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Compare numbers from 0 to 20
skills.description: Tell which of two numbers is greater or less. Find the number that is 1 or 2 more, or 1 or 2 less.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Break apart and build 10
skills.description: Show that a number is made of two smaller parts, like 6 is 4 and 2. Find the missing part.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Add and take away to 5
skills.description: Put groups together or take some away when the numbers stay 5 or less. Know answers like 2 and 3 make 5.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Add and subtract stories to 10
skills.description: Solve story problems about joining, taking away, parts, and comparing, with answers up to 10. Use counters or fingers to help.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Share equally
skills.description: Share things so every friend gets the same amount. Tell how many each friend gets.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Read and show numbers to 50
skills.description: Read numbers up to 50 in words and digits, and match them to tens and ones. Pick how a number is used, like on a clock or a house.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Skip count to 50
skills.description: Count to 50 by 1s, 2s, 5s, and 10s. What number comes next when you count by 5s? Use a number line or hundred chart to help.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Compare and order to 50
skills.description: Tell which number is greater or less. Put numbers up to 50 in order from least to greatest, or greatest to least.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Build and break apart numbers
skills.description: Put numbers together or break them into parts, like 28 is 20 and 8, or 10 and 10 and 8. The amount stays the same.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Fair shares for 2 or 4
skills.description: Look at the picture and tap what each friend gets when 2 or 4 friends share. Leftovers can be cut into equal pieces.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Halves and fourths
skills.description: Learn that one half of a whole is the same as two fourths of that same whole. Two halves or four fourths make one whole.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Compare shares of a whole
skills.description: When a whole is shared with more friends, each piece gets smaller. Look at the pictures and tap the biggest or smallest piece.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Add and subtract facts to 10
skills.description: Know addition facts up to 10 and the take-away facts that go with them. For example, 4 and 6 make 10, so 10 take away 4 is 6.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Any order, zero, and checking
skills.description: Adding in any order gives the same answer, and adding or taking away zero changes nothing. Use adding to check a take-away answer.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Quick adding and subtracting to 20
skills.description: Use tricks like counting on, making 10, and near doubles to add and subtract in your head. Your answers stay 20 or less.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Add and subtract stories to 50
skills.description: Use pictures, number lines, and equations to solve stories about joining, taking away, and comparing, up to 50. Find the missing number too.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Equal groups up to 10
skills.description: Look at the picture and tap how many in all, like 5 groups of 2, or 6 groups of one half. Or find how many groups there are.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Read and build numbers to 200
skills.description: Read and build numbers up to 200 with hundreds, tens, and ones. Break numbers apart in different ways, like 124 is 100 and 24, or 12 tens and 4 ones.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Compare and order to 200
skills.description: Tell which number is greater or less, up to 200. Put numbers in order from least to greatest or greatest to least.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Fair shares with leftover pieces
skills.description: Look at the picture and tap what each friend gets when up to 10 things are shared by 2, 3, 4, or 6 friends. Leftovers get cut into pieces, like 3 and one third.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: One third equals two sixths
skills.description: Share the same whole in thirds or in sixths. See that one third is the same amount as two sixths.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Adding and subtracting rules and checks
skills.description: Adding in any order gives the same answer, and zero changes nothing. Use adding to check taking away, and use equal jumps to see how adding links to multiplying.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Add and subtract facts to 20
skills.description: Know adding facts with totals up to 20, like 9 + 9 = 18, and the take-away facts that go with them. Use doubles and making 10 to help.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Equal groups and repeated adding
skills.description: Find how many in all when there are equal groups, like 4 groups of 5. Groups of one half and one fourth count too.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Share up to 12 equally
skills.description: Share up to 12 things equally. Find how many in each group, or how many groups you can make.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Read and build numbers to 1000
skills.description: Read and build numbers up to 1000 with hundreds, tens, and ones. Match them to words, digits, and spots on a number line, like 638 is 600 + 30 + 8.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Place value of each digit
skills.description: Tell what each digit is worth in a number, like the 5 in 511 means 5 hundreds. See that a zero holds a place and that each place is ten times bigger than the one next to it.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Compare and order to 1000
skills.description: Tell which of two numbers is greater or less, up to 1000. Put numbers in order from least to greatest or greatest to least.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Fair shares of up to 20
skills.description: Look at the picture and tap what each friend gets when up to 20 things are shared by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, or 10 friends. It can be a whole and a part, like 2 and two thirds.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Same share, different fractions
skills.description: See that different fractions can name the same amount, like one half and two fourths, or one fifth and two tenths. Use fair-share pictures to show it.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Show times and divide with arrays
skills.description: Use rows and columns of dots, called arrays, to show multiplying up to 10 × 10 and dividing up to 100 ÷ 10. Tell how many rows, how many in each row, and how many in all.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Facts for 2, 5, and 10
skills.description: Know the times facts for 2, 5, and 10, like 6 × 5 = 30. Know the matching share facts too, like 30 ÷ 5 = 6.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Times and divide rules
skills.description: Use rules to help you multiply, like 4 × 5 is the same as 5 × 4, and 4 × 6 is 4 × 5 plus 4 × 1. Use multiplying to check a divide answer.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Times and divide stories
skills.description: Solve stories about equal groups using hops on a number line or pictures. Some groups can be one half, one fourth, or one third, and you can find the total, the groups, or the size of each group.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Fractions as adding unit pieces
skills.description: See that three fifths is one fifth added three times. In a fraction like 3/5, the bottom number tells the size of the pieces and the top number counts them.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Fractions from halves to tenths
skills.description: Look at the picture and tap the fraction it shows, like 3/4 or 7/10. Know what the bottom number and the top number mean.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Compare and order fair shares
skills.description: Look at the pictures and tap who gets more when a whole is shared by different numbers of friends. Put the shares in order from least to greatest.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Count and add unit fractions
skills.description: Count by halves, thirds, fourths, and more, even past one whole, like 5 thirds. See that 4 one-thirds added up is 4 × 1/3, or 4/3.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Read and compare decimal tenths
skills.description: Read, show, compare, and order numbers like 0.6 and 24.7. The first digit after the dot counts tenths.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Fractions and decimal tenths match
skills.description: Show that fractions and decimals can name the same amount, like 1/2 and 0.5, or 15 tenths and 1.5.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Times and divide facts to 100
skills.description: Know all the times facts up to 10 × 10 and the divide facts that go with them, like 7 × 6 = 42 and 42 ÷ 6 = 7. Use facts you know to find new ones.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Equal fractions, improper and mixed
skills.description: Show that different fractions can be the same amount, like 2/3 and 4/6. Switch between improper fractions and mixed numbers, like 7/4 and 1 and 3/4.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Compare and order fractions
skills.description: Tell which fraction is bigger, even when they are more than one whole. Use pictures, number lines, or the benchmark of one half to put fractions in order.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Read and compare hundredths
skills.description: Read, show, compare, and order decimals like 3.25. The second digit after the dot counts hundredths, and 3.2 is the same as 3.20.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Fractions, decimals, and percents
skills.description: Show that a fraction, a decimal, and a percent can name the same amount, like 1/4, 0.25, and 25%. Percent means out of 100.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Add and subtract same-size fractions
skills.description: Add and subtract fractions that have the same bottom number, like 3/8 + 2/8. You are just adding or taking away pieces of the same size.

skills.subject: math
skills.title: Multiply and divide by unit fractions
skills.description: Find 4 × 1/3 by adding four one-thirds. Find 4 ÷ 1/3 by asking how many thirds fit in 4 wholes.
